name: swe-workflow-playground
description: Playground project for swe-workflow demonstrating Spec-Driven Development (SDD)

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k --kill-timeout 5000 -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && ./gradlew run" "cd frontend && npm run start:ja"
scripts.dev:ja: npm run db:up && concurrently -k --kill-timeout 5000 -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && ./gradlew run" "cd frontend && npm run start:ja"
scripts.dev:en: npm run db:up && concurrently -k --kill-timeout 5000 -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && ./gradlew run" "cd frontend && npm run start:en"
scripts.start: npm run db:up && concurrently -k --kill-timeout 5000 -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && ./gradlew run" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.test: node --test tests/dev-orchestrator.test.mjs && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
